section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1977
title: 26 ## Causes of Suicides: The total number of suicide cases reported during 1977 has been classified under different heads and the last category 'other causes' cover the unspecified causes of suicides. The major cause of suicides during 1977 was 'Dreadful diseases' which accounted for 16.7 percent of total number of suicides. The second important cause was 'Quarrel with parents-in-law' (10.1 per cent) followed by 'Quarrel with spouse' (6.5 per cent). 'Love affairs' (5.8 per cent), 'Poverty' (3.0 per cent), 'Dispute over property' (30 per cent) and 'Insanity' (2.9 per cent). Rest of the causes shared between 1.8 percent to 0.9 percent of the total number of suicides separately. The category 'other causes accounted for 46.2 per cent of the total suicides registered during 1977. The detailed statistics are presented in Table No. 3.
